generation.purpose: offline fixture creation only; FFmpeg is not a ReFusion build or runtime dependency
generation.command: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc2=size=320x180:rate=30 -frames:v 8 -an -vf format=nv12 -c:v h264_videotoolbox -profile:v high -level:v 3.1 -g 1 -bf 0 -b:v 800k -r 30 -color_range tv -color_primaries bt709 -color_trc bt709 -colorspace bt709 -bsf:v h264_metadata=aud=insert -f h264 video.h264
